tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_half_read
tests.intent: Verify that BJData ND-arrays with element type 'h' read successfully as 'half'.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_char_valid_range
tests.intent: Verify that ND-arrays of 'C' with values in 0..127 read successfully.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_char_invalid_range
tests.intent: Verify that ND-arrays of 'C' containing values > 127 throw a parse error on read.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_char_writer_restriction
tests.intent: Verify that the BJData writer does not pack 'C' arrays when elements exceed 127.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_char_writer_valid
tests.intent: Verify that the BJData writer packs 'C' arrays when elements are within 0..127.

tests.name: bjdata_version_api_check
tests.intent: Verify basic_json::bjdata_version_t usage and serialization compatibility.

tests.name: bjdata_bjd_type_name_half
tests.intent: Verify that binary reader internal type name mapping exposes 'half' for 'h'.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_uint8_preservation
tests.intent: Verify that unsigned 8-bit ND-arrays correctly pack and unpack without alterations.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_int8_range
tests.intent: Verify that int8 ND-arrays pack and unpack elements within signed range.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_float32_packing
tests.intent: Verify that float32 single precision ND-arrays pack correctly.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_float64_packing
tests.intent: Verify that float64 double precision ND-arrays pack correctly.

tests.name: bjdata_empty_ndarray_handling
tests.intent: Verify behavior of empty array structures in BJData processing.

tests.name: bjdata_invalid_ndarray_size_type
tests.intent: Verify handling of mismatched size descriptors in BJData arrays.

tests.name: bjdata_malformed_container_keys
tests.intent: Verify parser reaction to unexpected key combinations in ND-array candidates.

tests.name: bjdata_unsupported_draft_marker
tests.intent: Verify parser reaction to unsupported type markers or extension structures.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_int16_support
tests.intent: Verify that 16-bit signed integer ND-arrays pack and unpack accurately.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_uint16_support
tests.intent: Verify that 16-bit unsigned integer ND-arrays pack and unpack accurately.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_int32_support
tests.intent: Verify that 32-bit signed integer ND-arrays pack and unpack accurately.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_uint32_support
tests.intent: Verify that 32-bit unsigned integer ND-arrays pack and unpack accurately.

tests.name: bjdata_roundtrip_basic_types
tests.intent: Verify general BJData roundtripping for basic boolean and numeric types.

tests.intent: Verify basic_json::bjdata_version_t usage and serialization compatibility.
